remarks: Stunning yearly unfurnished rental at 14 White Barns in Norwalk's prestigious Cranbury area. This exceptional 4/5 bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home was built by Hobi Award-winning Able Construction. Spanning 15.4 acres, White Barns offers a unique blend of sophisticated, modern design and artisan craftsmanship. The open floor plan and exquisite finishes create a seamless flow throughout the living spaces, catering to today's lifestyle needs. This home offers the perfect balance of single-family autonomy and low- maintenance convenience. Surrounded by nature trails and the scenic Cranbury Park, this home is a sanctuary of tranquility and elegance. Ideal for discerning renters seeking a stress-free, luxurious lifestyle, 12 White Barns Lane is a rare opportunity to join a community where sophistication meets comfort. Photos are of a similar unit but finishes and layout may vary. Available mid- February 2026.
